name: mageme/module-eu-withdrawal-magic-link
description: One-click guest withdrawal access via signed magic-link tokens (configurable lifetime, 30-day default). Upgrades the withdrawal-CTA URL in order/shipment emails (shipped by the base module) from the lookup-form URL to a tokenised one-click variant. Pro tier UX add-on for mageme/module-eu-withdrawal. NOT legal advice — see README disclaimer; merchant is responsible for transactional-email compliance per jurisdiction.
